claims.paraphrase: Page title.
Page purpose line.
Each message on the page is quoted exactly as the editor shows it.
Section heading.
A failed email send shows a message to contact the site owner.
A too-soon repeat request shows a message to check the inbox or wait a minute.
An expired or used link shows the expired message or the confirm-page heading.
A failed confirm shows a This didn’t work heading with an error and a way back to sign in.
Advice to check the spam folder first.
An address the owner did not add receives no email.
Continuation of the ask-the-owner advice.
Section heading.
A refused save or publish keeps the typed text on screen.
A concurrent edit on Save shows the file-changed message, usually because another editor saved.
The draft is kept in the editor after the conflict.
Publish shows this only when the save half succeeded and the publish half conflicted.
A linter suppression comment explaining a Vale false positive on this page.
A save with broken internal links shows a singular or plural message, a list of addresses, and a Remove link button.
Closing marker of the Vale suppression.
A save linking to an unpublished page succeeds with a warning that the link will 404 until published.
Continuation of the unpublished-link warning.
A fragment cannot include another fragment.
A missing date on a dated entry is refused with a prompt to choose one.
An address already used by a published or pending entry is refused.
A linter suppression comment for a quoted contraction.
Saving a tag absent from the shared vocabulary is refused.
Closing marker of the contraction suppression.
Pointer to the tag list page.
Section heading.
A rename is blocked while the entry has unpublished edits.
Another open unpublished branch that references the entry blocks a rename.
The message names the editors to ask.
The rename stays blocked until the referencing drafts publish or are discarded.
Deleting an entry others link to or include is refused.
The refusal lists each linking entry with a link to its editor.
Section heading.
Publish site sends every pending entry live together.
A linter suppression comment for a quoted contraction.
Publish site with no pending entry says nothing is left to publish.
A commit conflict during Publish site loses nothing and asks for a reload.
An unexpected Publish site failure says to try again and ask the developer.
Closing marker of the contraction suppression.
Section heading.
A blocking draft refuses a revert with a message naming the editor and save time.
Reverting is blocked until the other editor publishes or discards their draft.
A stale history or unknown version refuses a revert with a reload message.
Section heading.
Sharing before saving is refused with a message to save an edit first.
Section heading.
An expired session shows a sign-in-again message on the share panel and the image insert.
Section heading.
A linter suppression comment for quoted upload messages.
An unsupported image format is refused with a message naming the accepted types.
A failed conversion shows a message to export as JPEG first.
An oversize image is refused with a too-large message.
A site limits the upload file size.
Continuation of the try-again advice.
A network failure during upload shows a connection message.
Closing marker of the contraction suppression.
Section heading.
An overlong draft is refused by Tidy with a message to select a passage.

Section heading.
Advice to report the exact message and steps to the owner or developer.
